mentions.name: Brain dump
mentions.description: A voice-based note-taking tool that performs transcription locally and saves notes as Markdown files to any folders the user sets up, helping with ideation, rumination, and to-do lists as a lower-friction alternative to typing.
mentions.problem: Writing notes is too high friction, so voice capture offers an easier alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Voice based note taking tool that does transcription locally

- Markdown files to any folder(s) you setup.

- Help with ideation, rumination, todolists

- Alternative to when writing is too high friction
